method.candidate_extra_area: C_i minus T_i from exact #1492 feature geometries; do not substitute geometries or simplify/snap/repair
method.shoreline: Transform only as required to suitable metric CRS with recorded axis order/datum; separately measure added-area intersection with Kystkontur and Landareal; compare full original 15/400/36 relational context; report feature-level contacts and distances only as diagnostics, not truth labels absent accuracy
method.topology: test parent containment/coverage, strict no-loss, all 36 neighbors/contact relations, and candidate/target validity; record precision, area units, exact source geometries and diagnostics
controls: verify input file and feature hashes before geometry
positive closure on unchanged exact #1492 relations
negative controls for deliberate source/identity or relation perturbations
preserve unmodified source geometries; do not apply unapproved repairs
method.interpretation: geometry predicates are source-specific diagnostics. Applicability, land/water, class, water/ice, territorial authority, history, cause, rights and ownership remain unknown absent adequate evidence.
method.coordinate_handling: Parse GML axis order from the declared CRS/schema (EPSG:4258 latitude,longitude); explicitly reorder to longitude,latitude before pyproj always_xy transformation into EPSG:4326 for source-relative geographic identity checks. For metric area and distance diagnostics transform a copy to ETRS89 / UTM zone 33N (EPSG:25833), suitable for this seven-case Northland extent. Record installed Python/Shapely/GEOS/pyproj versions and transform operation; if axis/CRS metadata is ambiguous or transform unavailable, stop rather than assume.
method.area_distance: Planar overlay/predicate area in EPSG:25833 square metres; distance diagnostics in metres in EPSG:25833. Report source CRS and transformations. Do not treat projected measures as positional accuracy or as physical applicability by themselves.
